newsitem.title: USA: Dow trades around 8,000, tech stocks buoyant.
newsitem.headline: Dow trades around 8,000, tech stocks buoyant.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks were slightly firmer Wednesday, with the Dow industrials flirting with the 8,000 level and the Nasdaq composite robust.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average, which broke through the 8,000 mark several times during the morning, was up 26 points at 8002 shortly before midday.
The Nasdaq composite was up 23 points, or 1.51 percent, to 1565. The index's technology stocks gained after bellwether chipmaker Intel Corp posted above-forecast results.
The long bond was up 15/32 at a 6.51 percent yield.
